title: Discovered attack
line: Move one piece and uncover an attack by another.

steps.text: Your knight stands between your rook and Black's queen. When the knight moves, the rook attacks the queen.
Move the knight with check, so Black has no time to save the queen.

summary: Move a piece off a line and the piece behind it attacks. If the moving piece threatens too, two attacks land at once.
